hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: PIT SEC business-combination and tender-offer filings (S-4, merger proxy, and tender forms) may identify corporate-action events that become positive when signal-day price action absorbs deal/dilution risk versus SPY before next-open default-off paper entry.

prediction.confidence_reason: M&A/tender SEC forms are a free PIT submissions surface with enough broad-universe coverage and are materially different from rejected financing/proxy/restructuring/accounting fields; the main risk is that deal economics are already priced or capped before next-open execution.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing SEC submissions cache, missing CIK mapping, missing business-combination/tender filing rows, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT SEC business-combination/tender forms, acceptance-time signal date, price-absorption gate, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The SEC business-combination/tender absorption source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_compression_pnl_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). The fixed bundle tested S-4, merger proxy, and tender-offer form families plus signal-day SPY-relative price absorption. The result is not retained or promoted.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.0734; aggregate PnL delta $+1,568.03; max drawdown drift +0.0005; 28 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping business-combination/tender form weights, S-4 amendment inclusion, signal excess, close-location, volume, volatility, ret20, price/ADV, event-age, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: If this fixed business-combination/tender absorption bundle fails, do not retry by sweeping form weights, S-4 amendment inclusion, signal excess, close-location, volume, volatility, ret20, price/ADV, event age, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows. A valid retry needs materially richer PIT deal economics such as cash/stock consideration, premium/discount, bidder/target role, break-fee, regulatory condition, shareholder vote status, or closed forward replacement-value rows.
